tools.name: return_stats
tools.title: Return statistics
tools.description: Summarize a return series: periods, annualized geometric return (CAGR) and volatility, Sharpe, max drawdown, skew, excess kurtosis, best and worst period, share positive.

tools.name: sharpe_ratio
tools.title: Sharpe ratio with standard error
tools.description: Compute the annualized Sharpe ratio with its standard error and 95% interval, under iid normal returns (Lo 2002) and allowing skew and fat tails (Mertens 2002). For the probability it beats luck across many trials, use canli-validation-mcp.

tools.name: sortino_ratio
tools.title: Sortino ratio
tools.description: Compute the annualized Sortino ratio: mean return above a target over downside deviation below it, with the downside deviation itself.

tools.name: max_drawdown
tools.title: Drawdowns
tools.description: Find the maximum drawdown and the worst drawdown episodes: depth, peak, trough, recovery and length in periods, plus time under water.

tools.name: calmar_ratio
tools.title: Calmar ratio
tools.description: Compute the Calmar ratio: annualized geometric return over the absolute maximum drawdown of the whole series.

tools.name: omega_ratio
tools.title: Omega ratio
tools.description: Compute the Omega ratio at a threshold: the sum of gains above it over the sum of losses below it.

tools.name: value_at_risk
tools.title: Value at risk
tools.description: Estimate value at risk as a positive loss fraction: historical, Gaussian and Cornish-Fisher (skew and kurtosis adjusted), over one or more periods.

tools.name: expected_shortfall
tools.title: Expected shortfall (CVaR)
tools.description: Estimate expected shortfall (CVaR): the average loss beyond value at risk, historical and Gaussian, as a positive loss fraction.

tools.name: capm_regression
tools.title: Alpha and beta (CAPM)
tools.description: Regress excess returns on benchmark excess returns: beta, alpha (annualized), their t-stats and p-values, R-squared, correlation and residual (idiosyncratic) volatility.

tools.name: information_ratio
tools.title: Information ratio and tracking error
tools.description: Compute active return, tracking error and the information ratio of a strategy against its benchmark, annualized.

tools.name: treynor_ratio
tools.title: Treynor ratio
tools.description: Compute the Treynor ratio: annualized excess return per unit of beta to the benchmark.

tools.name: m2_measure
tools.title: Modigliani M-squared
tools.description: Compute Modigliani's M-squared: the return the strategy would have earned levered to the benchmark's volatility, and its difference from the benchmark.

tools.name: capture_ratios
tools.title: Up and down capture
tools.description: Compute up-market and down-market capture: the strategy's annualized return in benchmark up periods and down periods, relative to the benchmark's.

tools.name: ulcer_index
tools.title: Ulcer index and Martin ratio
tools.description: Compute the Ulcer index (root-mean-square drawdown), the Martin (ulcer performance) ratio, and the pain index and pain ratio (mean drawdown).

tools.name: drawdown_at_risk
tools.title: Conditional drawdown at risk
tools.description: Estimate drawdown at risk (a drawdown quantile across periods) and conditional drawdown at risk (the mean drawdown beyond it), as positive fractions.

tools.name: tail_ratio
tools.title: Tail and Rachev ratios
tools.description: Compute the tail ratio (95th percentile return over the absolute 5th) and the Rachev ratio (mean of the best tail over the mean loss of the worst tail).

tools.name: gain_to_pain
tools.title: Gain-to-pain ratio
tools.description: Compute Schwager's gain-to-pain ratio: the sum of returns over the absolute sum of losing returns.

tools.name: trade_stats
tools.title: Trade statistics
tools.description: Summarize closed-trade results: win rate, profit factor, payoff ratio, expectancy, largest win and loss, and longest winning and losing streaks.

tools.name: kelly_fraction
tools.title: Kelly fraction
tools.description: Compute the growth-optimal (Kelly) fraction: from a return series (continuous, (mean - rf) / variance), or from a win probability and payoff odds. Also gives half Kelly.

tools.name: autocorrelation
tools.title: Autocorrelation and Ljung-Box
tools.description: Test a return series for serial correlation: autocorrelations at each lag and the Ljung-Box Q statistic with its p-value.

tools.name: normality_test
tools.title: Normality (Jarque-Bera)
tools.description: Test whether returns are normal with the Jarque-Bera test, with skew and excess kurtosis.

tools.name: autocorrelation_adjusted_sharpe
tools.title: Sharpe adjusted for autocorrelation
tools.description: Annualize a Sharpe ratio allowing for serial correlation (Lo 2002): smoothed or autocorrelated returns overstate the usual sqrt(time) Sharpe.

tools.name: rolling_sharpe
tools.title: Rolling Sharpe summary
tools.description: Summarize the rolling Sharpe ratio over a window: latest, min, max, median and the share of windows below zero; shows whether performance is stable or decaying.

tools.name: black_scholes
tools.title: Black-Scholes price and Greeks
tools.description: Price a European option under Black-Scholes-Merton with a dividend yield, with delta, gamma, vega, theta, rho, vanna, volga, charm, speed and the risk-neutral probability of finishing in the money.

tools.name: implied_volatility
tools.title: Implied volatility
tools.description: Solve for the Black-Scholes-Merton implied volatility of a European option from its price, refusing prices outside no-arbitrage bounds.

tools.name: black76
tools.title: Black-76 (options on futures)
tools.description: Price a European option on a futures or forward with Black-76, with delta, gamma and vega; also used for caps, floors and swaptions on a forward rate.

tools.name: bachelier
tools.title: Bachelier (normal model)
tools.description: Price a European option under the Bachelier normal model, which allows negative forwards (rates, spreads), with delta, gamma and vega.

tools.name: american_option
tools.title: American option (binomial tree)
tools.description: Price an American option with a dividend yield (binomial Black-Scholes with Richardson extrapolation), with the European price and the early-exercise premium.

tools.name: digital_option
tools.title: Digital (binary) option
tools.description: Price a European cash-or-nothing or asset-or-nothing digital option under Black-Scholes-Merton, with delta.

tools.name: put_call_parity
tools.title: Put-call parity check
tools.description: Check put-call parity for a European pair: the parity gap, the implied forward and the implied rate-minus-yield, to spot mispricing or stale quotes.

tools.name: option_strategy_payoff
tools.title: Multi-leg strategy payoff
tools.description: Evaluate a multi-leg options position at expiry (calls, puts, underlying): net premium, payoff and profit at chosen prices, breakevens, and maximum profit and loss.

tools.name: option_portfolio_greeks
tools.title: Portfolio Greeks
tools.description: Aggregate Black-Scholes-Merton Greeks across many option positions on one underlying: net delta, gamma, vega, theta, rho and the dollar delta and gamma.

tools.name: volatility_conversions
tools.title: Volatility conversions
tools.description: Convert volatility between periods and forms: annual to daily, weekly or monthly, the expected move over a horizon, and lognormal to approximate normal (basis point) volatility.

tools.name: vix_style_index
tools.title: Model-free implied volatility (VIX method)
tools.description: Compute a VIX-style model-free implied volatility from option chains with the CBOE method: forward from put-call parity, out-of-the-money strips with the two-zero-bid cutoff, per-expiry variance, and interpolation to a constant maturity (30 days by default).

tools.name: risk_neutral_density
tools.title: Risk-neutral density from option prices
tools.description: Recover the market's risk-neutral distribution from call prices across strikes (Breeden-Litzenberger): density and cumulative probability at each strike, its mean, volatility, skewness and kurtosis, probabilities beyond chosen levels, and strikes where the density is negative (butterfly arbitrage).

tools.name: sma
tools.title: Simple moving average
tools.description: Compute the simple moving average of closing prices over a lookback.

tools.name: ema
tools.title: Exponential moving average
tools.description: Compute the exponential moving average (seeded with the simple average, as TA-Lib does).

tools.name: wma
tools.title: Weighted moving average
tools.description: Compute the linearly weighted moving average (latest price weighted most).

tools.name: dema
tools.title: Double exponential moving average
tools.description: Compute the double exponential moving average (2 EMA - EMA of EMA), which lags less than an EMA.

tools.name: tema
tools.title: Triple exponential moving average
tools.description: Compute the triple exponential moving average (3 EMA - 3 EMA2 + EMA3).

tools.name: hull_moving_average
tools.title: Hull moving average
tools.description: Compute the Hull moving average, WMA(2 WMA(n/2) - WMA(n), sqrt n), a fast, smooth trend line.

tools.name: kama
tools.title: Kaufman adaptive moving average
tools.description: Compute Kaufman's adaptive moving average, which speeds up in trends and slows in noise (efficiency ratio, fast 2, slow 30).

tools.name: rsi
tools.title: Relative strength index
tools.description: Compute Wilder's relative strength index (0-100): above 70 often read as overbought, below 30 as oversold.

tools.name: macd
tools.title: MACD
tools.description: Compute MACD (fast EMA - slow EMA), its signal line and histogram, as TA-Lib does.

tools.name: bollinger_bands
tools.title: Bollinger Bands
tools.description: Compute Bollinger Bands: a moving average with bands k population standard deviations above and below, plus %B and bandwidth.

tools.name: stochastic
tools.title: Stochastic oscillator
tools.description: Compute the slow stochastic oscillator: %K (smoothed position of the close in the high-low range) and %D.

tools.name: williams_r
tools.title: Williams %R
tools.description: Compute Williams %R (-100 to 0): where the close sits in the recent high-low range.

tools.name: cci
tools.title: Commodity channel index
tools.description: Compute the commodity channel index: typical price's distance from its average in units of mean absolute deviation.

tools.name: atr
tools.title: Average true range
tools.description: Compute Wilder's average true range and its percent of price (NATR), the standard volatility measure for stops and sizing.

tools.name: adx
tools.title: Average directional index
tools.description: Compute Wilder's ADX trend strength with +DI and -DI (TA-Lib's smoothing): ADX above 25 is usually read as trending.

tools.name: obv
tools.title: On-balance volume
tools.description: Compute on-balance volume, the running sum of volume signed by the close's direction.

tools.name: money_flow_index
tools.title: Money flow index
tools.description: Compute the money flow index (volume-weighted RSI, 0-100) from typical price and volume.

tools.name: rate_of_change
tools.title: Rate of change and momentum
tools.description: Compute rate of change (percent change over n bars) and momentum (price difference over n bars).

tools.name: trix
tools.title: TRIX
tools.description: Compute TRIX, the one-bar percent change of a triple-smoothed EMA, a filtered momentum oscillator.

tools.name: aroon
tools.title: Aroon indicator
tools.description: Compute Aroon up and down (0-100: how recently the highest high and lowest low occurred) and the Aroon oscillator.

tools.name: chande_momentum
tools.title: Chande momentum oscillator
tools.description: Compute the Chande momentum oscillator (-100 to 100) with Wilder smoothing, as TA-Lib does.

tools.name: ultimate_oscillator
tools.title: Ultimate oscillator
tools.description: Compute Williams' ultimate oscillator, blending buying pressure over three horizons (7, 14, 28 by default).

tools.name: accumulation_distribution
tools.title: Accumulation/distribution and Chaikin oscillator
tools.description: Compute the Chaikin accumulation/distribution line and the Chaikin oscillator (fast EMA - slow EMA of the line).

tools.name: donchian_channels
tools.title: Donchian channels
tools.description: Compute Donchian channels: the highest high and lowest low over a lookback and their midpoint (breakout systems).

tools.name: keltner_channels
tools.title: Keltner channels
tools.description: Compute Keltner channels: an EMA of the close with bands a multiple of ATR above and below.

tools.name: vwap
tools.title: Volume-weighted average price
tools.description: Compute the cumulative volume-weighted average price from typical price, or a rolling VWAP over a window.

tools.name: ichimoku_cloud
tools.title: Ichimoku cloud
tools.description: Compute the Ichimoku lines: conversion (tenkan), base (kijun), leading spans A and B (shown at the bar they are computed, not shifted forward) and lagging span.

tools.name: rolling_zscore
tools.title: Rolling z-score
tools.description: Compute each price's z-score against its rolling mean and sample standard deviation, the basic mean-reversion signal.

tools.name: stochastic_rsi
tools.title: Stochastic RSI
tools.description: Compute the stochastic RSI: where RSI sits in its own recent range (%K, unsmoothed by default as in TA-Lib) and its moving average %D.

tools.name: parabolic_sar
tools.title: Parabolic SAR
tools.description: Compute Wilder's parabolic stop-and-reverse trailing stop with its trend direction (acceleration 0.02 step, 0.2 max by default).

tools.name: linear_regression
tools.title: Linear regression with robust errors
tools.description: Fit ordinary least squares of y on several regressors with classical, heteroskedasticity-robust (HC1) or Newey-West HAC standard errors, R-squared, F-test and AIC.

tools.name: factor_regression
tools.title: Factor model regression (alpha and betas)
tools.description: Regress a strategy's excess returns on factor returns (e.g. Fama-French market, size, value, momentum) with Newey-West errors: annualized alpha, its t-stat, factor betas and R-squared.

tools.name: adf_test
tools.title: Augmented Dickey-Fuller unit root test
tools.description: Test a price, spread or rate series for a unit root (non-stationarity) with the Augmented Dickey-Fuller test: statistic, MacKinnon p-value, critical values and the AIC-chosen lag.

tools.name: kpss_test
tools.title: KPSS stationarity test
tools.description: Test the null that a series is level- or trend-stationary with the KPSS test (Hobijn lag rule), complementing ADF; p-values are table-interpolated within 0.01-0.10.

tools.name: variance_ratio_test
tools.title: Lo-MacKinlay variance ratio test
tools.description: Test the random-walk hypothesis on prices with the Lo-MacKinlay variance ratio at one or more horizons (overlapping, de-biased, heteroskedasticity-robust): above 1 means trending, below 1 mean-reverting.

tools.name: cointegration_test
tools.title: Engle-Granger cointegration test
tools.description: Test whether two or more price series are cointegrated (Engle-Granger): hedge ratios, ADF on the residual spread with MacKinnon p-value and critical values, and the spread's half-life.

tools.name: mean_reversion_fit
tools.title: Mean reversion (Ornstein-Uhlenbeck) fit
tools.description: Fit an AR(1) / Ornstein-Uhlenbeck model to a spread or price series: half-life, mean, speed of reversion, equilibrium volatility and the current z-score.

tools.name: garch_volatility
tools.title: GARCH(1,1) volatility model
tools.description: Fit a GARCH(1,1) model with constant mean by maximum likelihood: omega, alpha, beta, persistence, long-run volatility, volatility half-life and the next-period volatility forecast.

tools.name: ewma_volatility
tools.title: EWMA (RiskMetrics) volatility
tools.description: Compute exponentially weighted volatility (RiskMetrics, lambda 0.94 by default): the current annualized estimate and optionally the full series.

tools.name: range_volatility
tools.title: Range-based volatility (OHLC)
tools.description: Estimate volatility from open, high, low and close prices with close-to-close, Parkinson, Garman-Klass, Rogers-Satchell and Yang-Zhang estimators, annualized.

tools.name: probabilistic_sharpe_ratio
tools.title: Probabilistic Sharpe ratio
tools.description: Compute the probability that the true Sharpe ratio exceeds a benchmark given the track record's length, skewness and kurtosis (Bailey and López de Prado), and the minimum track record length needed. Takes returns or prices, or just the observed Sharpe and the number of observations.

tools.name: deflated_sharpe_ratio
tools.title: Deflated Sharpe ratio
tools.description: Deflate a backtest's Sharpe ratio for the number of strategies tried (Bailey and López de Prado 2014): the expected maximum Sharpe under the null and the probability the result beats it. Takes returns or prices, or just the observed Sharpe and the number of observations, with the trials' Sharpe variance or Sharpes.

tools.name: pca_factors
tools.title: Principal components of returns
tools.description: Run principal component analysis on asset returns (correlation or covariance): explained variance per component, cumulative share and each component's loadings.

tools.name: rolling_beta
tools.title: Rolling beta
tools.description: Compute a rolling-window beta (and correlation) of returns against a benchmark: latest, average, minimum and maximum, optionally the full series.

tools.name: granger_causality
tools.title: Granger causality test
tools.description: Test whether past values of x help predict y beyond y's own past (Granger causality), with the F-test at each lag up to a maximum.

tools.name: arch_effects_test
tools.title: ARCH effects (Engle LM) test
tools.description: Test demeaned returns for volatility clustering with Engle's ARCH Lagrange multiplier test: LM statistic, chi-squared p-value, and the F version.

tools.name: mean_return_test
tools.title: Test that mean return is zero
tools.description: Test whether a strategy's mean return differs from zero (or a target) with a one-sample t-test and a Newey-West t-statistic robust to autocorrelation.

tools.name: compare_sharpe_ratios
tools.title: Compare two Sharpe ratios
tools.description: Test whether two strategies' Sharpe ratios differ (Jobson-Korkie with Memmel's correction) using their returns over the same periods.

tools.name: welch_t_test
tools.title: Welch two-sample t-test
tools.description: Test whether two samples (e.g. returns in two regimes, before and after a change) have different means, without assuming equal variances (Welch).

tools.name: markov_regime_switching
tools.title: Markov regime-switching model
tools.description: Fit a Hamilton Markov-switching model with a mean and volatility per regime (2 or 3 regimes) by maximum likelihood: regime means and volatilities, transition probabilities, expected durations, the current regime probabilities and how much time was spent in each.

tools.name: johansen_cointegration
tools.title: Johansen cointegration test
tools.description: Test how many cointegrating relationships tie several price series together (Johansen trace and maximum-eigenvalue tests with Osterwald-Lenum critical values), with the rank chosen at 5% and the normalized cointegrating vectors.

tools.name: recursive_stability_test
tools.title: Parameter stability (CUSUM)
tools.description: Check whether a regression's coefficients stayed stable over time: recursive least squares coefficient paths, and the CUSUM and CUSUM-of-squares tests of Brown, Durbin and Evans with 5% bounds and the first period each one crosses.

tools.name: chow_break_test
tools.title: Structural break (Chow) test
tools.description: Test for a structural break in a regression at a known period (Chow F-test), or scan every candidate break inside a trimmed range for the largest F statistic and where it falls.

tools.name: har_rv_forecast
tools.title: HAR realized-volatility forecast
tools.description: Fit Corsi's heterogeneous autoregressive (HAR) model of realized variance on its daily, weekly and monthly averages, with Newey-West errors, and forecast variance and volatility over the next horizon.

tools.name: realized_volatility_measures
tools.title: Realized volatility and jumps
tools.description: From intraday returns per day, compute realized variance, bipower variation, the jump component and the Barndorff-Nielsen-Shephard jump test (tripower quarticity), realized semivariances, realized skewness and kurtosis, and the daily series for HAR forecasts.

tools.name: dependence_measures
tools.title: Dependence beyond correlation
tools.description: Measure how two series move together: Pearson, Spearman and Kendall correlations with p-values, distance correlation (catches nonlinear dependence), and empirical lower and upper tail dependence (do they crash together?).

tools.name: bootstrap_confidence_interval
tools.title: Block-bootstrap confidence interval
tools.description: Put a confidence interval on a performance statistic (Sharpe, Sortino, CAGR, volatility, max drawdown, Calmar, mean) with the stationary block bootstrap, which keeps autocorrelation and volatility clustering; also gives the bootstrap standard error and the share of resamples at or below zero.

tools.name: barrier_option
tools.title: Barrier option (knock-in, knock-out)
tools.description: Price a continuously monitored single-barrier option (down/up, in/out, call/put, with rebate) in closed form (Reiner-Rubinstein), with the vanilla price and the barrier discount.

tools.name: asian_option_geometric
tools.title: Geometric average Asian option
tools.description: Price a continuously averaged geometric-average-price Asian option in closed form (Kemna-Vorst); a lower bound and control variate for the arithmetic Asian.

tools.name: heston_option
tools.title: Heston stochastic volatility option
tools.description: Price a European option under the Heston stochastic-volatility model by Fourier integration of its characteristic function, with delta, in-the-money probability and the Feller condition.

tools.name: sabr_volatility
tools.title: SABR implied volatility
tools.description: Compute the Black implied volatility of a strike under the SABR model (Hagan et al. 2002) from alpha, beta, nu and rho, optionally across several strikes for a smile.

tools.name: spread_option
tools.title: Spread option (Kirk)
tools.description: Price a European option on the spread between two futures (F1 - F2 - K) with Kirk's approximation, as used for crack and spark spreads.

tools.name: exchange_option
tools.title: Exchange option (Margrabe)
tools.description: Price the option to exchange one asset for another, max(Q1 S1 - Q2 S2, 0), in closed form (Margrabe), with dividend yields on both.

tools.name: lookback_option
tools.title: Floating-strike lookback option
tools.description: Price a continuously monitored floating-strike lookback option (Goldman-Sosin-Gatto): a call pays the final price minus the minimum, a put the maximum minus the final price.

tools.name: chooser_option
tools.title: Simple chooser option
tools.description: Price a simple chooser option, which lets the holder decide at a choice date whether it is a call or a put with the same strike and expiry (Rubinstein).

tools.name: jump_diffusion_option
tools.title: Merton jump-diffusion option
tools.description: Price a European option under Merton's jump-diffusion model (lognormal jumps) as a Poisson-weighted sum of Black-Scholes prices.

tools.name: bond_price
tools.title: Bond price, duration and convexity
tools.description: Price a fixed-rate bond from its yield on real dates and a day count: clean and dirty price, accrued interest, Macaulay and modified duration, convexity and DV01.

tools.name: bond_yield
tools.title: Bond yield to maturity
tools.description: Solve a fixed-rate bond's yield to maturity from its clean price, with duration, convexity and DV01 at that yield.

tools.name: zero_coupon_bond
tools.title: Zero-coupon bond price and yield
tools.description: Price a zero-coupon bond from its yield or solve the yield from its price, under annual, periodic or continuous compounding, with duration and convexity.

tools.name: bootstrap_zero_curve
tools.title: Bootstrap a zero curve from par yields
tools.description: Bootstrap discount factors, zero rates (continuous and periodic) and period forward rates from par yields, interpolating par yields linearly onto the coupon grid.

tools.name: forward_rate
tools.title: Forward rate between two dates
tools.description: Compute the forward rate between two maturities implied by their zero rates, under continuous, periodic or simple compounding, with the forward discount factor.

tools.name: nelson_siegel_fit
tools.title: Nelson-Siegel yield curve fit
tools.description: Fit a Nelson-Siegel curve (level, slope, curvature, decay tau) to observed yields by least squares, with fitted yields and RMSE; tau is searched when not given.

tools.name: interest_rate_swap
tools.title: Interest rate swap value and par rate
tools.description: Value a spot-starting fixed-for-floating swap on a zero curve (single curve): par swap rate, value to the fixed payer, fixed-leg annuity and DV01s.

tools.name: forward_rate_agreement
tools.title: Forward rate agreement value
tools.description: Value a forward rate agreement on a zero curve: the simple forward rate for the period and the value to the party that pays the fixed rate.

tools.name: z_spread
tools.title: Z-spread over a zero curve
tools.description: Solve a fixed-rate bond's z-spread: the constant spread over a continuously compounded zero curve that reprices its cash flows to the market dirty price.

tools.name: credit_hazard_rate
tools.title: Hazard rate and default probability from a spread
tools.description: Convert a credit spread and recovery rate into a constant hazard rate (credit triangle), survival and default probabilities over a horizon, and the reverse.

tools.name: short_rate_bond_price
tools.title: Vasicek or CIR zero-coupon bond
tools.description: Price a zero-coupon bond and its yield under the Vasicek or Cox-Ingersoll-Ross short-rate model in closed form.

tools.name: treasury_bill_yields
tools.title: Treasury bill yields
tools.description: Convert a T-bill's price or bank discount rate into the discount yield, bond-equivalent (investment) yield, money-market yield and effective annual yield.

tools.name: key_rate_durations
tools.title: Key rate durations
tools.description: Measure a fixed-rate bond's sensitivity to each pillar of a zero curve: bump one pillar by 1 bp (triangular bump, linear in between) and reprice, giving key rate DV01s and durations that sum to the parallel figure.

tools.name: breakeven_inflation
tools.title: Breakeven inflation
tools.description: Compute breakeven inflation from a nominal and a real (inflation-linked) yield of the same maturity, exactly (Fisher) and approximately, and the real yield implied by an inflation view.

tools.name: merton_credit_risk
tools.title: Merton structural credit risk
tools.description: Back out a firm's asset value and asset volatility from its equity value and equity volatility with Merton's model (equity as a call on assets), then the distance to default, default probability, the implied credit spread and the value of the debt.

tools.name: portfolio_var
tools.title: Portfolio VaR and expected shortfall
tools.description: Compute a positions portfolio's historical and parametric (normal) value at risk and expected shortfall from asset return history, with each position's contribution and the diversification benefit.

tools.name: stress_test
tools.title: Scenario stress test
tools.description: Apply named scenarios (a return shock per position, or a market shock passed through each position's beta) to a portfolio and report the P&L of each scenario and the worst position.

tools.name: option_scenario_grid
tools.title: Option book scenario grid
tools.description: Revalue a book of European options and stock under a grid of spot moves and volatility shifts (full Black-Scholes revaluation), with P&L per cell and the book's current Greeks.

tools.name: exposure_and_hedge
tools.title: Gross, net and beta-adjusted exposure
tools.description: Summarize a long/short book's gross, net and beta-adjusted exposure and size an index hedge (futures contracts or ETF shares) that neutralizes the beta.

tools.name: concentration_metrics
tools.title: Concentration metrics
tools.description: Measure how concentrated a portfolio is: Herfindahl index, effective number of positions, largest and top-k shares, and the Gini coefficient of weights.

tools.name: liquidation_horizon
tools.title: Liquidation horizon
tools.description: Estimate how many days each position takes to exit at a maximum share of average daily volume, and how much of the book can be liquidated within 1, 5 and 20 days.

tools.name: extreme_value_tail
tools.title: Extreme value tail risk (EVT)
tools.description: Model the loss tail with extreme value theory: fit a generalized Pareto distribution to losses beyond a high threshold (peaks over threshold) and estimate value at risk and expected shortfall far into the tail, with the Hill tail index.

tools.name: convert_returns
tools.title: Convert prices and returns
tools.description: Convert between prices, simple returns and log returns, or rebase a price series to start at 100; returns the converted series.

tools.name: resample_returns
tools.title: Resample returns to weeks, months or years
tools.description: Compound periodic returns into calendar weeks (ISO), months, quarters or years using their dates.

tools.name: monthly_returns_table
tools.title: Calendar monthly returns table
tools.description: Build the year-by-month return table from periodic returns and dates, with each year's compounded total, the best and worst months and the share of positive months.

tools.name: brinson_attribution
tools.title: Brinson-Fachler performance attribution
tools.description: Attribute active return to allocation, selection and interaction effects by segment (Brinson-Fachler) from portfolio and benchmark weights and returns.

tools.name: portfolio_risk
tools.title: Portfolio risk decomposition
tools.description: Decompose a portfolio's volatility into each asset's risk contribution, with marginal risk, diversification ratio, effective number of assets, parametric VaR and ex-ante tracking error to a benchmark.

tools.name: min_variance_portfolio
tools.title: Minimum variance portfolio
tools.description: Find the fully invested minimum-variance portfolio, long-only with an optional weight cap (exact active-set solution) or unconstrained (closed form).

tools.name: max_sharpe_portfolio
tools.title: Maximum Sharpe (tangency) portfolio
tools.description: Find the portfolio with the highest Sharpe ratio, long-only (exact) or unconstrained (closed form tangency), with its expected return, volatility and Sharpe.

tools.name: mean_variance_portfolio
tools.title: Mean-variance portfolio for a target
tools.description: Find the minimum-variance portfolio that reaches a target expected return, or the utility-maximizing portfolio for a risk aversion, long-only or unconstrained.

tools.name: risk_parity_portfolio
tools.title: Risk parity (equal risk contribution)
tools.description: Find long-only weights where every asset contributes equally (or by a given budget) to portfolio volatility, solved by Newton's method.

tools.name: inverse_volatility_weights
tools.title: Inverse volatility weights
tools.description: Weight assets in proportion to the inverse of their volatility (or variance), the simple risk-balancing heuristic.

tools.name: hierarchical_risk_parity
tools.title: Hierarchical risk parity
tools.description: Allocate with López de Prado's hierarchical risk parity: single-linkage clustering on correlation distance, quasi-diagonal ordering and recursive bisection.

tools.name: efficient_frontier
tools.title: Efficient frontier
tools.description: Trace the efficient frontier: minimum volatility at evenly spaced target returns from the minimum-variance portfolio to the highest-return asset, with weights.

tools.name: black_litterman
tools.title: Black-Litterman posterior returns
tools.description: Blend market-implied equilibrium returns with your views (absolute or relative, with confidence) into Black-Litterman posterior returns and the unconstrained optimal weights.

tools.name: covariance_shrinkage
tools.title: Ledoit-Wolf covariance shrinkage
tools.description: Estimate a well-conditioned covariance matrix by Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage toward a scaled identity, with the shrinkage intensity and condition numbers before and after.

tools.name: correlation_matrix
tools.title: Correlation matrix
tools.description: Compute Pearson or Spearman rank correlations between assets, with the average pairwise correlation and the largest eigenvalue's share (how much one factor drives everything).

tools.name: rebalance_trades
tools.title: Rebalancing trades
tools.description: Turn current holdings and target weights into the share trades that rebalance the portfolio, with turnover, optional no-trade bands, and cash left over.

tools.name: kelly_portfolio
tools.title: Multi-asset Kelly weights
tools.description: Compute growth-optimal (Kelly) weights across assets, inverse covariance times excess returns, with half-Kelly and the implied leverage and growth rate.

tools.name: max_diversification_portfolio
tools.title: Maximum diversification portfolio
tools.description: Find the long-only portfolio with the highest diversification ratio (weighted average volatility over portfolio volatility), Choueifaty and Coignard's most-diversified portfolio.

tools.name: index_tracking_portfolio
tools.title: Index tracking portfolio
tools.description: Find long-only weights in a subset of assets that minimize ex-ante tracking error to a benchmark's weights, with an optional per-asset cap.

tools.name: almgren_chriss_schedule
tools.title: Almgren-Chriss optimal execution
tools.description: Compute the Almgren-Chriss optimal liquidation schedule for a block: holdings and trades per period, expected impact cost and its standard deviation for a given risk aversion.

tools.name: market_impact_estimate
tools.title: Square-root market impact
tools.description: Estimate the cost of an order with the square-root impact law (cost = Y x volatility x sqrt(order / daily volume)) plus half the spread, in basis points and currency.

tools.name: implementation_shortfall
tools.title: Implementation shortfall
tools.description: Measure an executed order's implementation shortfall against the decision price, split into delay, execution (impact), opportunity cost of unfilled shares and fees.

tools.name: execution_schedule
tools.title: TWAP / VWAP order schedule
tools.description: Split an order across time buckets evenly (TWAP) or by an expected volume profile (VWAP), capped at a maximum participation rate, with what cannot be done within the horizon.

tools.name: spread_estimators
tools.title: Bid-ask spread from prices (Roll, Corwin-Schultz)
tools.description: Estimate the effective bid-ask spread from trade prices alone (Roll 1984) and from daily highs and lows (Corwin-Schultz 2012) when quotes are not available.

tools.name: liquidity_measures
tools.title: Amihud illiquidity and Kyle's lambda
tools.description: Measure price impact per unit of trading: Amihud illiquidity (|return| per currency traded) and Kyle's lambda (price change per signed volume, by regression).

tools.name: order_book_analysis
tools.title: Order book walk and microprice
tools.description: Analyze an order book snapshot: mid, spread, microprice, depth imbalance, and the average fill price and slippage of a market order of a given size walking the book.

tools.name: position_size_from_stop
tools.title: Position size from a stop loss
tools.description: Size a trade so that hitting the stop loses a fixed fraction of equity: shares, notional, capital at risk and leverage, optionally capped by a maximum position weight.

tools.name: volatility_target_size
tools.title: Volatility-targeted position
tools.description: Scale a position so its expected volatility matches a target: the weight (leverage) from the asset's volatility, shares for a given equity, optionally capped.

tools.name: optimal_f
tools.title: Optimal f (Ralph Vince)
tools.description: Find the fraction f of the largest loss to risk per trade that maximizes terminal wealth over a list of trade results (Vince's optimal f), with the geometric mean and the f-based position size.

tools.name: trade_expectancy
tools.title: Trade expectancy and break-even win rate
tools.description: Compute a trading rule's expectancy per trade after costs, the break-even win rate for its payoff, and the payoff needed at its win rate.

tools.name: drawdown_probability
tools.title: Probability of a drawdown
tools.description: Estimate the probability that a strategy with a given return and volatility ever falls a given fraction below its starting equity (drifted Brownian motion, continuous), and within a horizon.

tools.name: leverage_and_margin
tools.title: Leverage, margin and liquidation distance
tools.description: Compute leverage, initial and maintenance margin, free margin, and the adverse price move that triggers a margin call for a leveraged position.

tools.name: var_position_limit
tools.title: Position limit from a VaR budget
tools.description: Find the largest position whose one-day (or n-day) parametric value at risk stays within a budget, given the asset's volatility.

tools.name: funding_rate_carry
tools.title: Perpetual funding rate carry
tools.description: Annualize perpetual-futures funding rates (simple APR and compounded APY) and compute the funding a position pays or earns over a holding period; accepts one rate or a history.

tools.name: futures_basis
tools.title: Futures basis and implied rate
tools.description: Compute a dated future's basis to spot, its annualized carry (simple and compounded) and the implied financing rate, for cash-and-carry trades.

tools.name: liquidation_price
tools.title: Isolated-margin liquidation price
tools.description: Estimate a leveraged position's liquidation price under isolated margin: initial margin = 1/leverage, liquidated when equity falls to the maintenance rate (exchange formulas add fees and tiers).

tools.name: fx_forward
tools.title: FX forward by covered interest parity
tools.description: Price an FX forward from spot and the two currencies' money-market rates (covered interest parity, ACT/360 or ACT/365), with forward points in pips, or back out the implied rate from a quoted forward.

tools.name: fx_cross_rate
tools.title: FX cross rate with bid and ask
tools.description: Derive a cross rate's bid and ask from two quotes against a common currency (e.g. EURJPY from EURUSD and USDJPY), handling which side each leg is quoted on.

tools.name: triangular_arbitrage
tools.title: Triangular arbitrage check
tools.description: Check three currency (or crypto) quotes for triangular arbitrage after spreads and fees: the return of each direction around the triangle.

tools.name: pip_value
tools.title: FX pip value and position size
tools.description: Compute the value of one pip for a lot size in the account currency, and the lot size that risks a given amount over a stop distance in pips.

tools.name: carry_trade_return
tools.title: Currency carry trade return
tools.description: Decompose a carry trade's return into the interest differential and the spot move, and find the break-even depreciation of the high-yield currency.

tools.name: impermanent_loss
tools.title: AMM impermanent loss
tools.description: Compute impermanent (divergence) loss of a liquidity position versus holding, for a constant-product pool or a concentrated range (Uniswap v3 style), given the price change.

tools.name: backtest_ma_crossover
tools.title: Backtest a moving-average crossover
tools.description: Backtest a fast/slow moving-average crossover on your prices with costs and no lookahead: CAGR, Sharpe, drawdown, turnover, cost drag and buy-and-hold for comparison.

tools.name: backtest_time_series_momentum
tools.title: Backtest time-series momentum
tools.description: Backtest time-series (absolute) momentum: hold the asset when its trailing return is positive, optionally volatility-targeted, with costs and no lookahead.

tools.name: backtest_breakout
tools.title: Backtest a channel breakout
tools.description: Backtest a Donchian channel breakout (turtle-style entries on new highs, exits on shorter lows) with costs and no lookahead.

tools.name: backtest_zscore_reversion
tools.title: Backtest z-score mean reversion
tools.description: Backtest mean reversion on a rolling z-score of price: buy stretched lows (and short stretched highs), exit near the mean, with costs.

tools.name: backtest_rsi_reversion
tools.title: Backtest RSI mean reversion
tools.description: Backtest a classic RSI oversold strategy: buy when RSI is below a threshold, sell when it recovers, with costs and no lookahead.

tools.name: backtest_volatility_target
tools.title: Backtest volatility targeting
tools.description: Backtest holding an asset scaled to a constant volatility target with trailing realized volatility, leverage cap and rebalance frequency.

tools.name: backtest_cross_sectional_momentum
tools.title: Backtest cross-sectional momentum
tools.description: Backtest cross-sectional (relative) momentum across a universe: periodically hold the top assets by trailing return (skipping the latest month), optionally short the bottom.

tools.name: backtest_dual_momentum
tools.title: Backtest dual momentum
tools.description: Backtest dual momentum (Antonacci): hold the best-performing risky asset when it beats cash or a safe asset, otherwise move to safety.

tools.name: backtest_risk_parity_rebalance
tools.title: Backtest inverse-volatility risk parity
tools.description: Backtest a multi-asset inverse-volatility (naive risk parity) portfolio rebalanced periodically, optionally scaled to a volatility target.

tools.name: backtest_trend_ensemble
tools.title: Backtest a trend ensemble
tools.description: Backtest a multi-horizon trend signal: the average of time-series momentum signs over several lookbacks, optionally volatility-targeted, with costs and no lookahead.

tools.name: backtest_macd_trend
tools.title: Backtest MACD trend following
tools.description: Backtest the MACD line against its signal line (long above, flat or short below) with costs and no lookahead.

tools.name: backtest_equal_weight_rebalance
tools.title: Backtest an equal-weight portfolio
tools.description: Backtest equal weights across a universe rebalanced on a fixed schedule; the 1/N benchmark that optimized portfolios must beat.

tools.name: backtest_min_variance_rebalance
tools.title: Backtest minimum variance
tools.description: Backtest the long-only minimum-variance portfolio re-estimated from trailing sample covariance on a fixed schedule, with costs.

tools.name: backtest_low_volatility
tools.title: Backtest the low-volatility anomaly
tools.description: Backtest holding the lowest-volatility fraction of a universe, re-ranked on a schedule, with costs and no lookahead.

tools.name: backtest_short_term_reversal
tools.title: Backtest short-term reversal
tools.description: Backtest buying the recent biggest losers in a universe (and optionally shorting the winners), re-ranked on a schedule, with costs.

tools.name: backtest_trend_filter_allocation
tools.title: Backtest a trend-filtered allocation
tools.description: Backtest tactical asset allocation where each asset is held only while above its moving average (Faber-style), equal or inverse-volatility weighted.

tools.name: backtest_high_proximity
tools.title: Backtest 52-week-high momentum
tools.description: Backtest holding the assets trading closest to their trailing high (George-Hwang 52-week-high momentum), re-ranked on a schedule.

tools.name: backtest_pairs_trading
tools.title: Backtest pairs trading
tools.description: Backtest a pairs trade on two price series: rolling hedge ratio, z-score of the residual spread, market-neutral entries and exits, with costs.

tools.name: backtest_weights
tools.title: Backtest your own target weights
tools.description: Backtest any strategy from your own target weights per period (decided at each close, applied to the next period) with the same costed, drift-aware engine; null rows mean hold.

tools.name: strategy_sweep
tools.title: Parameter sweep with deflated Sharpe
tools.description: Run one strategy recipe over a parameter grid (up to 400 variants), rank the variants by Sharpe, and deflate the best one for the number tried, so tuning cannot pass off luck as skill.

tools.name: list_sleeves
tools.title: List strategy sleeves
tools.description: Browse the library of 399 pre-defined strategy sleeves (18 families: trend, momentum, reversion, volatility, allocation, pairs). Each is a fixed rule with a spec hash; filter by family, data shape or words.

tools.name: describe_sleeve
tools.title: Describe a sleeve
tools.description: One sleeve's exact rule, parameters, warm-up, rationale, published references, known risks and spec SHA-256.

tools.name: run_sleeve
tools.title: Run a sleeve on your prices
tools.description: Backtest one library sleeve on your prices with costs and no lookahead: CAGR, Sharpe, drawdown, turnover, cost drag, and the target weights as of the latest close (ready for a paper rebalance).

tools.name: sleeve_tournament
tools.title: Run every sleeve, corrected for multiple testing
tools.description: Run all library sleeves that fit your prices (up to 399) on a common window and rank them, then correct for the search: deflated Sharpe (raw and effective number of trials), White's Reality Check, re-studentized Hansen SPA and Romano-Wolf StepM against a benchmark, and the probability of backtest overfitting (CSCV).

tools.name: sleeve_walk_forward
tools.title: Walk-forward sleeve selection
tools.description: Test the selection process itself: at each refit pick the top sleeves by trailing Sharpe, hold them for the next window, repeat. Compares the out-of-sample result with what the picks showed in sample, with holding every sleeve, and with the benchmark.

tools.name: combine_sleeves
tools.title: Combine sleeves into one book
tools.description: Blend chosen sleeves (equal or trailing inverse-volatility weights, no lookahead) into one book: its statistics, each sleeve's, their correlations, the diversification ratio, and the book's combined asset target weights as of the latest close.

tools.name: sleeve_clusters
tools.title: Cluster sleeves by behavior
tools.description: Group the sleeves that ran on your prices by return correlation (average linkage on sqrt((1 - rho) / 2)), to see how many genuinely different bets the library makes on this data and the best sleeve of each group.

tools.name: sleeve_regime_map
tools.title: Sleeve performance by market regime
tools.description: Score every sleeve that fits your prices in each regime of the benchmark: calm, normal and turbulent volatility (terciles of trailing volatility) and up or down trend (above or below its moving average). Finds sleeves that held up in every regime.

tools.name: check_price_series
tools.title: Check a price series
tools.description: Check a price series for errors before using it: non-positive or missing values, unadjusted splits, outlier returns, stale runs, duplicate, unsorted or gapped timestamps.

tools.name: check_ohlc_bars
tools.title: Check OHLC bars
tools.description: Check open-high-low-close-volume bars for impossible values: high below open/close, low above them, negative volume, zero-range bars, and extreme overnight gaps.

tools.name: check_option_chain
tools.title: Check an option chain for arbitrage and bad quotes
tools.description: Check one expiry of an option chain: crossed or negative quotes, prices outside no-arbitrage bounds, non-monotone or non-convex prices across strikes, put-call parity breaks, and quotes with no implied volatility.

tools.name: check_yield_curve
tools.title: Check a yield curve
tools.description: Check a zero curve for problems: unsorted tenors, discount factors that rise with maturity, negative or jumpy implied forward rates, and kinks far from neighbouring points.

tools.name: check_funding_rates
tools.title: Check perpetual funding data
tools.description: Check a perpetual-futures funding history: irregular intervals, rates beyond the venue's cap, outliers, and long one-sided runs, with the annualized range.

tools.name: check_cross_venue_prices
tools.title: Check prices across venues
tools.description: Compare the same instrument's prices across venues at the same times: deviation of each venue from the cross-venue median, venues that stop updating, and the worst divergences.

tools.name: check_timestamps
tools.title: Check timestamps
tools.description: Check a column of timestamps: unparseable values, duplicates, out-of-order rows, mixed time-zone offsets, dates in the future and weekend entries, with the spacing distribution.

tools.name: check_returns_series
tools.title: Check a returns series
tools.description: Check a returns series for the usual mistakes: percents instead of fractions, impossible simple returns below -100%, constant or zero-filled stretches, extreme values and smoothing (high lag-1 autocorrelation).

tools.name: check_fundamentals
tools.title: Check financial statement identities
tools.description: Check reported fundamentals against accounting identities: assets = liabilities + equity, current within total, gross profit = revenue - cost of revenue, cash-flow sections summing to the change in cash, and EPS x shares close to net income.

tools.name: check_corporate_actions
tools.title: Detect corporate actions from raw and adjusted prices
tools.description: Detect splits and dividends by comparing raw and adjusted close series: each change in the adjustment factor, classified as a split (ratio) or a dividend (percent), with mismatches flagged.

tools.name: cusum_filter_events
tools.title: Sample events with a CUSUM filter
tools.description: Sample the periods worth labeling with the symmetric CUSUM filter on log prices: an event fires when the cumulative up or down move since the last event exceeds a threshold (fixed, or a multiple of recent volatility), so labels concentrate on meaningful moves instead of every bar.

tools.name: triple_barrier_labels
tools.title: Triple-barrier labels
tools.description: Label events with the triple-barrier method: a profit-take and a stop-loss set as multiples of recent volatility, and a time limit; each label is which barrier was touched first (+1, -1, or the sign at the time limit), with the touch period so overlapping labels can be purged. With a side per period it produces meta-labels (1 = the bet paid).

tools.name: fixed_horizon_labels
tools.title: Fixed-horizon labels
tools.description: Label each period by its forward return over a fixed horizon: +1 above a threshold, -1 below minus the threshold, 0 between; the threshold can be fixed or scaled by recent volatility. Includes the class balance and the forward span each label covers.

tools.name: trend_scanning_labels
tools.title: Trend-scanning labels
tools.description: Label each period by the strongest forward trend: regress prices on time over every forward window in a range, keep the window with the largest |t-statistic| of the slope, and label by its sign with the t-statistic as confidence (Lopez de Prado's trend scanning).

tools.name: sample_weights
tools.title: Weights for overlapping labels
tools.description: Weight labels whose spans overlap so a model does not over-count the same information: concurrency per period, each label's average uniqueness, return-attribution weights, and optional time decay (Lopez de Prado, chapter 4).

tools.name: purged_cv_splits
tools.title: Purged, embargoed cross-validation
tools.description: Build k-fold cross-validation splits for labels that span time without leakage: training labels whose spans overlap a test fold are purged, and labels starting just after a test fold are embargoed. Reports what each fold removed, and optionally the indices.

tools.name: annotate_price_series
tools.title: Annotate a price series
tools.description: Annotate every period of a price series and list the notable ones: robust-z outlier moves, stale (repeated) prices, gaps (jumps across a period), drawdown episodes with peak, trough and recovery, new all-time highs, and the causal volatility regime (calm, normal, turbulent). Gives per-period tags for joining onto your own data.

tools.name: net_present_value
tools.title: Net present value
tools.description: Compute the NPV of periodic cash flows (first at time 0), with the profitability index, discounted payback and the IRR when one exists.

tools.name: internal_rate_of_return
tools.title: Internal rate of return
tools.description: Solve the IRR of periodic cash flows, warning when sign changes allow several IRRs, with the NPV profile at a few rates.

tools.name: modified_irr
tools.title: Modified internal rate of return
tools.description: Compute the MIRR: negative flows discounted at a finance rate, positive flows compounded at a reinvestment rate, one unambiguous return.

tools.name: xnpv_xirr
tools.title: Dated NPV and IRR (XNPV, XIRR)
tools.description: Compute NPV and IRR for cash flows on irregular dates (ACT/365 from the first date), as spreadsheet XNPV and XIRR do.

tools.name: time_value_solver
tools.title: Time value of money solver
tools.description: Solve for any one of rate, number of periods, payment, present value or future value given the other four (loans, savings, annuities), payments at period end or start.

tools.name: amortization_schedule
tools.title: Loan amortization schedule
tools.description: Build a level-payment loan schedule: payment, interest and principal per period, remaining balance, and total interest.

tools.name: rate_conversion
tools.title: Interest rate conversion
tools.description: Convert a nominal rate between compounding frequencies, to effective annual and continuous rates, and remove inflation (exact Fisher real rate).

tools.name: growing_annuity
tools.title: Growing annuity and perpetuity
tools.description: Value a growing annuity (present and future value) or a growing perpetuity whose first payment arrives in one period.

tools.name: payback_period
tools.title: Payback and discounted payback
tools.description: Compute simple and discounted payback periods, interpolated within the period that recovers the investment.

tools.name: equivalent_annual_annuity
tools.title: Equivalent annual annuity
tools.description: Convert a project's NPV into an equivalent level annual amount, to compare projects with different lives.

tools.name: wacc
tools.title: Weighted average cost of capital
tools.description: Compute WACC from market values and costs of equity, debt and preferred, with after-tax cost of debt; cost of equity can come from CAPM.

tools.name: levered_beta
tools.title: Unlever and relever beta
tools.description: Unlever an observed equity beta to an asset beta and relever it at a target debt-to-equity ratio (Hamada), for comparable-company cost of equity.

tools.name: break_even
tools.title: Break-even and operating leverage
tools.description: Compute break-even units and revenue, contribution margin, margin of safety and degree of operating leverage from price, variable cost and fixed costs.

tools.name: loan_true_cost
tools.title: Loan APR with fees
tools.description: Find a loan's true annual cost when upfront fees reduce the cash received: the payment, the nominal APR and effective annual rate implied by the fees, and the total cost.

tools.name: retirement_projection
tools.title: Savings and withdrawal projection
tools.description: Project a savings balance with yearly contributions growing with salary, then sustainable inflation-adjusted withdrawals; reports the balance at retirement, how long withdrawals last and the safe level spending.

tools.name: dcf_valuation
tools.title: Discounted cash flow valuation
tools.description: Value a business from forecast free cash flows with a Gordon-growth or exit-multiple terminal value: enterprise and equity value, per-share value and a discount-rate by growth sensitivity grid.

tools.name: reverse_dcf
tools.title: Reverse DCF (implied growth)
tools.description: Solve the free-cash-flow growth rate the current share price implies over a forecast horizon, given a discount rate and terminal growth.

tools.name: dividend_discount_model
tools.title: Dividend discount models
tools.description: Value a share with the Gordon growth, two-stage or H-model dividend discount model, or back out the required return the price implies (Gordon).

tools.name: residual_income_valuation
tools.title: Residual income valuation
tools.description: Value equity as book value plus discounted residual income (earnings above the cost of equity on opening book), with clean-surplus book values and a terminal value.

tools.name: enterprise_value_multiples
tools.title: Enterprise value bridge and multiples
tools.description: Build enterprise value from market cap, debt, preferred, minority interest and cash, then EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT, EV/sales, P/E, P/B, earnings yield and FCF yield.

tools.name: altman_z_score
tools.title: Altman Z-score
tools.description: Compute the Altman Z-score bankruptcy predictor (public manufacturing, private-firm Z', or non-manufacturing Z'') with its five ratios and zone.

tools.name: piotroski_f_score
tools.title: Piotroski F-score
tools.description: Score a company's financial strength 0-9 from two years of statements: profitability, leverage and liquidity, and operating efficiency signals, each shown.

tools.name: beneish_m_score
tools.title: Beneish M-score
tools.description: Compute the eight-variable Beneish M-score earnings-manipulation screen from two years of statements, with every index; above -1.78 flags likely manipulation.

tools.name: dupont_analysis
tools.title: DuPont ROE decomposition
tools.description: Decompose return on equity into margin, asset turnover and leverage (three-step), and into tax burden, interest burden, operating margin, turnover and leverage (five-step).

tools.name: graham_valuation
tools.title: Graham number and growth formula
tools.description: Compute Benjamin Graham's number (sqrt 22.5 x EPS x book value per share) and his revised growth formula value, with margin of safety against a price.

tools.name: validate_deflated_sharpe
tools.title: Validate deflated Sharpe
tools.description: Deflated Sharpe ratio: the probability (0 to 1) that the selected strategy's Sharpe beats the best that luck gives across the variants tried, with the probabilistic Sharpe and that luck benchmark. Send the seven statistics or a return series. With every variant's returns use validate_overfitting; luck as a trial count, validate_luck_trials; a multiple-testing haircut, validate_haircut_sharpe. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

tools.name: validate_overfitting
tools.title: Validate overfitting (CSCV)
tools.description: Probability of backtest overfitting (0 to 1) by CSCV: how often the in-sample best variant falls below the out-of-sample median. Needs every variant's returns (periods by variants); with summary statistics only, use validate_deflated_sharpe. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

tools.name: validate_reality_check
tools.title: Data-snooping tests (SPA, Reality Check, StepM)
tools.description: Data-snooping tests on every variant a search tried: Hansen's SPA p-value that the best beat the benchmark only by luck, White's Reality Check, and the variants Romano-Wolf StepM finds better. Send all variants tried, not only the winners. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

tools.name: validate_paper_evidence
tools.title: Validate paper evidence
tools.description: Checks paper-evidence.v0 structure and disclosures. With CANLI_LOCAL=1, record_file reads an export bundle and journal_file verifies signatures, source hashes and recomputed claims. Without a journal, source facts and signatures are unchecked. Local files are never uploaded. This verdict is about the series exactly as submitted. The service never saw the data source, its costs, survivorship, or any lookahead in how the series was built.

tools.name: validate_breadth
tools.title: Validate breadth ceiling
tools.description: Book Sharpe ceiling from adding sleeves of this quality and correlation, the Sharpe at a sleeve count, and the sleeves a target needs. For portfolio construction; it validates no single strategy. This verdict is about the series exactly as submitted. The service never saw the data source, its costs, survivorship, or any lookahead in how the series was built.

tools.name: validate_track_record
tools.title: Minimum track record length
tools.description: Minimum track record length (observations and years) for an observed Sharpe to beat a benchmark at a confidence level; with observations, the record's probabilistic Sharpe so far. For live or paper records; to size a backtest for its trials, use validate_backtest_length. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

tools.name: validate_backtest_length
tools.title: Minimum backtest length
tools.description: Minimum backtest length (years) before the best of N independent trials is not expected to reach a target Sharpe by luck; with backtest_years, the most trials those years allow. For planning a search; once it has a result, use validate_deflated_sharpe. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

tools.name: validate_haircut_sharpe
tools.title: Haircut Sharpe ratio
tools.description: Haircut Sharpe for multiple testing (Harvey and Liu 2015): the Sharpe a single test would have needed, by Bonferroni and independent tests, and with the other tests' Sharpes, Holm and BHY. For the probability the Sharpe is real, use validate_deflated_sharpe. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

tools.name: validate_luck_trials
tools.title: Luck-equivalent trials
tools.description: How many skill-less strategies a search would need for its best to reach this Sharpe by luck (Monte Carlo), and with a trial count, the chance it did. States luck as the best of N random tries; for the probability the Sharpe is real, use validate_deflated_sharpe. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

tools.name: audit_backtest
tools.title: Audit a backtest
tools.description: One-call audit of a strategy's returns. Headline: one test whose false-positive rate was measured on nine return shapes (White's Reality Check with variants, luck trials with Lo's correction without). Then deflated Sharpe, minimum track record and, with variants, overfitting and out-of-sample decay, each with its receipt, plus fix_next. Send every variant tried (variants_file) so trials are counted; point returns_file at a CSV instead of pasting. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.title: Verify a receipt
tools.description: Verify a receipt offline: its Ed25519 signature against the bundled canlicapital.com key, its output hash and its id. Send an id to fetch it first, or the receipt itself. The receipt is content-hashed, reproducible from the open-source core it names, and signed with Ed25519 by a key published at https://canlicapital.com/.well-known/canli-receipt-keys.json.

tools.name: backtest_strategy
tools.title: Backtest a rule over a parameter grid, validated
tools.description: Backtest a rule on your prices over a whole parameter grid, then validate the best with the count of variants actually run: deflated Sharpe, overfitting probability, minimum track record, vs buy and hold, after costs. A backtest, deflated or not, is not a forecast and not advice.

tools.name: summarize_series
tools.title: Summarize a price or return series
tools.description: A long price or return series in about 100 words plus fields: growth, risk, dated drawdowns, trend, volatility regime, tails, jumps, stale data. Use instead of reading raw bars. Nothing here is a forecast or advice.

tools.name: strategy_stress_test
tools.title: Stress-test a strategy's returns
tools.description: Stress a strategy's returns: bootstrap histories (how often the drawdown limit breaks or Sharpe turns negative) and named crash, volatility, repeat and stuck-position scenarios, with a fragility share. Frequencies over resampled histories are not forecasts of the future.

tools.name: check_feasibility
tools.title: Check a plan against broker limits and impact
tools.description: Check a trading plan before it trades: broker order-rate and minimum-order limits, 2026 US day-trading rules, square-root market impact with crowding, and the capital where costs eat the return. Checks the plan as described against published broker limits and a market-impact model; it never contacts a broker or sees an account.

tools.name: check_leakage
tools.title: Check a signal for lookahead
tools.description: Does a signal look ahead? plan gives cuts; rerun your code on the first cut rows for each, then compare. Rows that changed used later rows; the result names the pattern and horizon. No code is sent. A pass covers only these cuts: the columns are the caller's, and survivorship, vendor revisions or a leak no cut reaches leave no trace.

tools.name: placebo_test
tools.title: Test a research pipeline on placebo data
tools.description: Does your pipeline find edges in noise? plan writes placebo files (your data's returns in random orders, so nothing is predictable); run the whole pipeline on real.csv and on each, then compare for a p-value that counts every choice it makes. Beating the placebos shows the pipeline finds more in the real order of the returns than in random orders of the same returns; it does not show the edge survives costs, capacity or the future.

tools.name: known_as_of
tools.title: Known as of a date
tools.description: Get what a company had reported as of a date: per measure, the latest period filed by then, its value, and whether it was later restated; optionally ratios from those filings. For point-in-time backtests.

tools.name: history
tools.title: Measure history
tools.description: Get a measure (or several, with concepts) over time, newest first: latest (default), first reported, or as known on a filing date, with its filing, other version and yearly change.

tools.name: restatements
tools.title: Restated periods
tools.description: List periods whose value changed in a later filing, with first and latest values, % change and cause (stock splits left out by default). Omit concept to scan everything.

tools.name: vintages
tools.title: Filing vintages
tools.description: List every filing that reported one period of one measure, oldest first: the revision history behind a number.

tools.name: list_concepts
tools.title: List concepts
tools.description: List the XBRL concepts a company reports and the plain names it supports, with units, periods, date range and restated-period counts.

tools.name: find_company
tools.title: Find a company
tools.description: Find a company's SEC CIK and tickers by name, ticker or CIK. The other tools also take a name as company.

tools.name: cross_section
tools.title: Cross-section as of a date
tools.description: Get one measure for up to 50 companies as filed by a date: each one's latest period, its value then, and whether it was later restated. For point-in-time peer and factor work.

tools.name: search_research
tools.title: Search research
tools.description: Find Canli Capital research papers (strategy tests, killed candidates, literature reviews, feasibility protocols) by words in their titles and summaries. Use it to find a paper's slug, then read it with get_paper; to browse by subject instead, use list_topics.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.title: Research topics
tools.description: The research topics, with how many papers each holds and what it covers.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.title: Read a paper
tools.description: A research paper's text as published, by slug, with its headings; send section for one part, and max_chars to cap the length. Find the slug with search_research or list_topics first.

tools.name: trial_ledger
tools.title: Trial ledger
tools.description: How many distinct hypotheses Canli Capital has tried against its declared budget, and how many were killed or survived. Use it to judge any published result against the size of the search behind it.

tools.name: live_record
tools.title: Live paper record
tools.description: The live paper-trading record (returns, costs, risk, corrections, provenance) and each sleeve's paper equity, with their limits. Use it for how the strategies are doing now; for why they exist, read the papers.

tools.name: chain_head
tools.title: Verification chain head
tools.description: The head of the tamper-evident chain that shows the published record was not rewritten after publication, with where to verify it. Use it to check that a figure you read was not changed later.

tools.name: list_factors
tools.title: Point-in-time factors
tools.description: The point-in-time factors pit_factor builds from SEC filings, and what each measures.

tools.name: pit_factor
tools.title: Build a point-in-time factor
tools.description: Build a factor from SEC filings for a list of tickers, monthly from start to end, using only what had been filed by each date (restatements invisible until filed). Writes a signal CSV for backtest_signal. Values are what companies reported to the SEC in XBRL, as filed by each date; a company that files late, files outside XBRL or changes its tags can be missing.

tools.name: backtest_signal
tools.title: Backtest a signal without lookahead
tools.description: Backtest a signal against your prices: rank, long and short quantiles, rebalance, trading only on what was known lag_days earlier, costs on actual trades. Pass ledger to judge the best of a search against all of it. A backtest measures one path of history under these costs; it does not establish that the signal will keep working.

tools.name: price_panel
tools.title: Build a price panel
tools.description: Build a price panel from free sources for breadth_book or backtest_signal: the tickers you name or an index fund's current holdings, daily adjusted closes and dollar volume, and each company's Fama-French industry from its SEC SIC code, written as CSV files.

tools.name: breadth_signals
tools.title: Breadth lab signals
tools.description: The cross-sectional signals breadth_book builds sleeves from: momentum, reversal, low volatility and beta, idiosyncratic risk, lottery demand, skewness, price delay, seasonality and liquidity, each with its formula's source and the data it needs.

tools.name: breadth_book
tools.title: Breadth book of sleeves
tools.description: Build many weakly correlated sleeves (every signal inside every group of names) from your price panel and trade them as one netted account, ALPHAC's breadth lab: rank-weighted within each group, overlapping portfolios, hedged and scaled to a volatility target, costs on actual trades. Returns the book netted and standalone, the netting ratio, effective independent bets and ideas, and writes every sleeve's returns as a training dataset. A sleeve built on many signals and groups is a search: report the number of sleeves, keep a period untouched for the test, and judge the book there, not on the years used to choose it.

tools.name: breadth_sweep
tools.title: Parallel sweep of breadth settings
tools.description: Run a grid of breadth-book settings (signal sets, smoothing, target volatility, costs, minimum names) in parallel on every core of this machine, or as shards other machines run and merge_files joins. Every combination counts as a trial: the best Sharpe is set against what the best of that many trials reaches by luck, and with split_date the chosen settings are scored after the split.

tools.name: effective_bets
tools.title: Effective independent bets
tools.description: How many independent bets a set of return series holds: the participation ratio of their weekly correlations (n for unrelated series, 1 for copies), and with families, the families' bets and the ideas they cluster into.

tools.name: annotation_packet
tools.title: Annotation packets
tools.description: Start a labelled dataset: figures (company, measure, period, value) are checked by machine against the SEC filings and written as blind CSV packets for two or more people to label, with guidelines and a key holding the machine labels.

tools.name: annotation_agreement
tools.title: Annotation agreement
tools.description: Read filled annotation packets: how often the people agree (Cohen's kappa), how often they agree with the machine, and every disagreement.

tools.name: annotation_gold
tools.title: Annotation gold set
tools.description: Merge filled annotation packets and a reviewer's decisions into a gold dataset (JSONL: each item's label, who decided it, the machine label and source) with a datasheet of agreement and hashes.

tools.name: verify_claims
tools.title: Verify claims against filings
tools.description: Check a draft answer's figures against the company's own filings before using them: revenue, net income, EPS, operating income, margins, growth, cash flow, assets, debt and more, for a fiscal year or quarter as the company labels it. US and foreign filers (20-F, IFRS), in their own currency. Each claim comes back confirmed, contradicted (with the filed figure and what the claimed one matches instead: another year, a quarter, a unit slip), not reported or not checkable.

tools.name: european_filings
tools.title: European filings (ESEF)
tools.description: A European company's annual financial report as it filed it in the European Single Electronic Format (ESEF): revenue, operating and net profit, EPS, assets, equity, cash, cash flows and dividends as the company tagged them (IFRS concepts, its currency, full scale), with the comparatives, the report's viewer link and the other years on file. Issuers on EU and EEA regulated markets, found by name or LEI; words find any other tagged figure.

tools.name: reference_rates
tools.title: Reference and policy rates
tools.description: Money-market and policy rates from the central banks themselves: SOFR, TGCR, BGCR, EFFR and OBFR from the New York Fed (with percentiles and volume), the euro short-term rate and the ECB's policy rates, SONIA and Bank Rate from the Bank of England, and about forty central banks' policy rates as the BIS collects them (policy:JP, policy:Brazil). Dates and rates, oldest first.

tools.name: prediction_markets
tools.title: Prediction markets
tools.description: What traders on Polymarket and Kalshi are paying for an outcome, found by words (a Fed decision, a recession, an election, a price level): each market's probability (the middle of bid and ask, else the last trade), bid, ask, volume and closing date, with the event's resolution rules.

tools.name: crypto_fundamentals
tools.title: Crypto fundamentals (DefiLlama)
tools.description: A DeFi protocol's total value locked (now, by chain, and its history), the fees users pay it and the revenue it keeps (24 hours to all time); a chain's total value locked; or a stablecoin's supply in circulation and its change, by chain. From DefiLlama's open data.

tools.name: financial_statements
tools.title: Financial statements as filed
tools.description: A company's financial statements exactly as filed: income statement, balance sheet, cash flow and equity statement from its 10-K (or 10-Q), with its own line labels, each line's XBRL concept and the values as the filing shows them (units say the scale). Joins several filings by period; a line a later filing restated, or that a stock split changed, is shown beside its first-reported figure, never mixed in.

tools.name: filing_tables
tools.title: Tables in filings
tools.description: The table in a filing that holds a figure, found by words ("paid members", "revenue by region", "guidance"): XBRL statement and detail reports and the tables in the document itself (MD&A figures such as members, stores or ARPU), or an 8-K press release's tables. With filings above one, the same words in each earlier filing, to follow a figure over the years. Without words, lists the tables.

tools.name: earnings_release
tools.title: Earnings release and guidance
tools.description: A quarter's results press release (8-K Item 2.02): the headline, the results it states (each with the part of the business it belongs to and what a change is measured against), its guidance parsed into ranges (low, high, midpoint, unit, measure, basis, period, and the sentence or table row), and the previous release's guidance for this quarter set against the company's results: above, within or below the range, in basis points for rates.

tools.name: screen_companies
tools.title: Screen companies
tools.description: Screen every US-listed company (thousands, from SEC XBRL frames) on fundamentals: revenue, growth, margins, ROE, ROA, free cash flow, R&D intensity, leverage and more, for a calendar year or each company's fiscal year ending in a date window, with filters, ranking and optional valuation (price, market cap, P/E, P/S, FCF yield). Implausible figures (tagging slips) are held out and listed apart.

tools.name: company_report
tools.title: Company report
tools.description: One company in one call: profile, five fiscal years of financials (revenue, growth, margins, net income, EPS, cash flow, ROE, leverage), price and risk over a year (return, volatility, drawdown, beta), valuation (market cap, P/E, P/S, FCF yield), insider buying and selling, and recent filings, each from its source.

tools.name: event_study
tools.title: Event study
tools.description: How a stock's price reacted to events: earnings releases (8-K item 2.02), insider purchases or sales (Form 4), any 8-K, or given dates. Abnormal returns against a market model, cumulative abnormal return per event and on average, with a t test across events.

tools.name: mentions_trend
tools.title: Mentions over time
tools.description: How often a word or phrase appears in SEC filings over time (by month, quarter or year), across all filers or one company, from EDGAR full-text search: for themes such as "tariffs", "agentic AI" or "going concern".

tools.name: company_profile
tools.title: Company profile
tools.description: A company's or fund's SEC profile by ticker, CIK or name: tickers, exchange, industry (SIC), fiscal year end, state, address, former names, and its latest 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K and 13F.

tools.name: list_filings
tools.title: List filings
tools.description: A company's SEC filings, newest first, filtered by form type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, DEF 14A, S-1, 4, 13F-HR...) and dates, with links. Use read_filing to read one.

tools.name: read_filing
tools.title: Read a filing
tools.description: The text of an SEC filing: the latest of a form, or one by accession.
